title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 01/2017
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > lead deck (?) > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII 90's, recording by Craig L.

ai_review.summary: Clear recording with a brief drop‑out, capturing a spacy spring ’82 show highlighted by a smoking The Other One and solid set list.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate the show four stars, noting a strong, space‑filled second half that culminates in a smoking performance of "The Other One" and an early “Satisfaction.”  The audio sounds great overall with just enough audience bleed, though one listener reports a drop‑out at the very end of the tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for energy and standout jams; recording is generally clear with only a minor dropout, leading to an overall strong but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp sound with sufficient audience presence; a noticeable drop‑out occurs at the end of the recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed, spacey first half followed by a high‑energy second set featuring strong drum jams and a smoking The Other One.

band_member_comments.Drums: Great space jam leading into a smoking The Other One.
